comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Deliver 300 Safflower to Hormuz in 75 days or less. Your reward is clothes! Which come from this chest:

Arab Merchants Trunk

A one-time use consumable item, it gives you the choice between one of these two outfits:

Safflower Dolman (male-only
Safflower Chadri (female-only)
